name: off-handoff-admission-counts-prompt-and-tools
description: official-host.ts:484 'explicit handoff admission counts the real prompt and active tool schemas'. A helper hook AFTER posthorse forces the system prompt to a size computed from the model window, the active tool schemas and posthorse's own guidance (the test's arithmetic), so exactly 4,500 chars of handoff fit: a 5,000-char handoff is refused ('too large ... limit 4,500'), a 4,000-char one commits and the fresh window holds only the handoff and the current guidance.

extensions.name: admit.ts
